metadata.title: Agentic attack detections for Microsoft Sentinel: everything
metadata.description: 33 analytics rules, 129 hunting queries and the AGENTIC_IOCs watchlist. Built by tools/build_sentinel.py from https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
Name of the Log Analytics workspace with Microsoft Sentinel on. It must be in the resource group you deploy to.
Start the analytics rules enabled. Off by default: review and baseline them first.

properties.displayName: AI agent CLI starts attack tools
properties.description:
A scanner, a Kerberos or SMB attack tool or an exploit kit started under an AI agent CLI: Claude Code (through its
shell-snapshots shell or its Windows shell launcher), Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, Codex, opencode, Hermes or Cairn's workers.
Tools written in Python, Ruby or Perl (sqlmap, NetExec, wpscan, nikto) run as their interpreter and are found by the
script in the command line.
The agent is found from the process tree or its command line, not from an auto-approve flag: staff use those flags
too, and an agent can run an attack tool without one. Tools are read from the last hour, agent processes from the
last day. Whatever model is behind it, this is agentic AI running an attack tool: check who ran it and the target.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (cross-framework behavior): https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
let AttackTools = dynamic(["nmap", "naabu", "masscan", "nuclei", "katana", "dalfox", "ffuf", "gobuster", "feroxbuster",
    "dirsearch", "nikto", "sqlmap", "wpscan", "hydra", "medusa", "kerbrute", "netexec", "nxc", "crackmapexec",
    "bloodyad", "coercer", "enum4linux-ng", "chisel", "pwncat", "pwncat-cs", "evil-winrm", "responder",
    "cloudfox", "msfconsole", "searchsploit", "hashcat"]);
let AgentBinaries = dynamic(["claude", "codex", "qwen", "kimi", "opencode", "hermes"]);
let AgentCommandLine = @'(?i)(@anthropic-ai[/\\]claude-code|@qwen-code[/\\]|@openai[/\\]codex|kimi[-_]cli|opencode-ai|(^"?|[/\\])(claude|codex|qwen|kimi|opencode)(\.exe|\.cmd|\.js)?"?(\s|$)|--provider cairn|model_provider="cairn"|/tmp/cairn-pi/)';
let AutoApproveFlag = @'(--dangerously-skip-permissions|--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox|\s--yolo\b|\s--auto-approve\b|--approval-mode[\s=]+yolo)';
let ScriptTool = @'(?i)/(sqlmap|nikto|wpscan|netexec|nxc|crackmapexec|bloodyad|coercer|evil-winrm|msfconsole|dirsearch|enum4linux-ng|pwncat|pwncat-cs|responder)(\s|$)|[/\\ ]((sqlmap|bloodyad|dirsearch|enum4linux-ng)\.py|nikto\.pl)|(^|[/\\ ])(coercer[/\\]coercer|responder[/\\]responder)\.py';
let Tools = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | extend Tool = replace_string(tolower(FileName), ".exe", "")
    | extend ScriptName = iff(FileName matches regex @'(?i)^(python|ruby|perl)', tolower(extract(ScriptTool, 0, ProcessCommandLine)), "")
    | where Tool in (AttackTools) or isnotempty(ScriptName) or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("impacket-", "ysoserial", "jwt_tool", "PayloadsAllTheThings", "/home/kali/pocs/")
    | extend Tool = iff(isnotempty(ScriptName), trim(@'[/\\\s]+', ScriptName), Tool);
let ByTree = Tools
    | extend Via = case(
        InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "shell-snapshots" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_LAUNCHER_SCRIPT", "Claude Code shell is the parent",
        replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName), ".exe", "") in (AgentBinaries), strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " is the parent"),
        replace_string(tolower(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), ".exe", "") in (AgentBinaries), strcat(InitiatingProcessParentFileName, " is the grandparent"),
        "")
    | where isnotempty(Via)
    | extend AgentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Agents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex AgentCommandLine
    | project DeviceId, AgentPid=ProcessId, AgentTime=TimeGenerated, AgentCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let ByAgentProcess = Tools
    | join kind=inner Agents on DeviceId
    | where TimeGenerated between (AgentTime .. (AgentTime + 7d)) and (InitiatingProcessParentId == AgentPid or InitiatingProcessId == AgentPid)
    | summarize arg_max(AgentTime, AgentCmd) by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, TimeGenerated, FileName, Tool, ProcessCommandLine, ProcessId
    | extend Via = "agent found by its command line";
union ByTree, ByAgentProcess
| summarize Tools=make_set(Tool, 20), Commands=make_set(substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 200), 15),
    FirstTool=min(TimeGenerated), LastTool=max(TimeGenerated), Via=make_set(Via, 5), AgentCmds=make_set(substring(AgentCmd, 0, 300), 5)
    by DeviceName, AccountName
| extend AutoApprove = tostring(AgentCmds) matches regex AutoApproveFlag, CairnMarker = tostring(AgentCmds) contains "cairn"

properties.displayName: Configuration or backup file served to an external address during probing
properties.description:
An internet address received a 200 or 206 for a source-control, environment or backup file (.git/HEAD, .env,
backup.zip, database dumps) while requesting several such paths. JPCERT/CC lists configuration and backup file theft in
Case E (Cairn, CyberStrikeAI and ARTEX), and the AI agents Scutum observed swept these paths across hundreds of folders.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (cross-framework behavior, first written for Cairn): https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
let BackupPath = @"(?i)(/\.git/(HEAD|config)|/\.env(\.bak|\.old|\.backup|\.local)?$|/\.svn/|backup\.(zip|tar|tar\.gz|sql)|db_back|database\.sql|dump\.sql|wp-config\.php\.(bak|old|save))";
W3CIISLog
| where not(ipv4_is_private(cIP)) and csUriStem matches regex BackupPath
| summarize Requests=count(), Served=countif(scStatus in ("200", "206")), Paths=dcount(csUriStem), Sample=make_set(csUriStem, 10) by cIP, csHost
| where Served > 0 and Paths >= 3

properties.displayName: ARTEX agent shell or recording proxy credential on a host
properties.description:
A process carried a marker that only the ARTEX binary creates: its "bash" shim in a temporary artex-exec- folder
(server/execpriv.go, server/execpriv_unix.go:539-575), the MCP launcher argument "__artex-exec-drop", or the recording
proxy credential "artex-pace:artex-pace" that ARTEX puts in every agent shell's HTTP_PROXY (egress/pace.go:20).
Someone is running ARTEX on this host: an authorized tester, an insider or an intruder staging from your network.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FolderPath contains "/artex-exec-" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath contains "/artex-exec-"
    or ProcessCommandLine contains "__artex-exec-drop" or ProcessCommandLine contains "artex-pace:artex-pace"
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "__artex-exec-drop" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine contains "artex-pace:artex-pace"
| summarize Events=count(), Commands=make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 20), Accounts=make_set(AccountName, 5),
    Parents=make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath, 5), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceName, DeviceId

properties.displayName: CloudWatch logs searched for secrets
properties.description:
FilterLogEvents with a filter pattern for passwords or access keys, as Datadog observed with a stolen key in ARTEX activity.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventSource == "logs.amazonaws.com" and EventName == "FilterLogEvents"
| extend Pattern = tostring(parse_json(RequestParameters).filterPattern), Limit = toint(parse_json(RequestParameters).limit)
| where Pattern has_any ("password", "AKIA", "secret", "token") or Limit == 1000
| summarize Calls=count(), LogGroups=dcount(tostring(parse_json(RequestParameters).logGroupName)), Patterns=make_set(Pattern, 10), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress, UserAgent

properties.displayName: Burst of EC2 DryRun permission tests
properties.description:
Ten or more EC2 calls with the DryRun flag from one identity in five minutes, the capability check ARTEX agents run with a stolen AWS key.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
AWSCloudTrail
| where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com" and ErrorCode == "Client.DryRunOperation"
| summarize DryRuns=count(), Actions=dcount(EventName), ActionList=make_set(EventName, 30), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by UserIdentityArn, SourceIpAddress, UserAgent, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where DryRuns >= 10

properties.displayName: Password spray at a fixed one-second rhythm
properties.description:
One source failed sign-ins for many users with a median gap of two seconds or less, the rhythm Microsoft observed in Storm-0940 ARTEX sprays.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where ResultType != "0"
| project TimeGenerated, IPAddress, UserAgent, UserPrincipalName, ResultType
| sort by IPAddress asc, UserAgent asc, TimeGenerated asc
| extend GapSec = iff(IPAddress == prev(IPAddress) and UserAgent == prev(UserAgent), datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, prev(TimeGenerated)), long(null))
| summarize Attempts=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName), MedianGapSec=percentile(GapSec, 50), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by IPAddress, UserAgent
| where Attempts >= 200 and Users >= 20 and MedianGapSec <= 2

properties.displayName: ARTEX code-default user agents (norma WebFetch, update check)
properties.description:
A sign-in, Graph call or web request carried a user agent hard-coded in the ARTEX source or its agent library:
"norma/0.4" from the WebFetch tool (BaaRai/Norma v0.4.11, tool/webfetch.go:236) or "artex-update-check" from the
console's update check (server/update_check.go:69). A real norma client only sends GET and never fetches static assets,
so web rows that break that pattern are dropped. Other agents built on norma share its user agent: treat a match as a lead.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
let CodeUA = dynamic(["norma/0.4", "artex-update-check"]);
let StaticExt = dynamic([".js", ".css", ".map", ".png", ".jpg", ".gif", ".svg", ".ico", ".woff", ".woff2", ".ttf"]);
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs | where UserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="SigninLogs", Account=UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent, Target=AppDisplayName, Method="", Url=""),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where UserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", Account=UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent, Target=AppDisplayName, Method="", Url=""),
    (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs | where UserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", Account=coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId, AppId), IPAddress, UserAgent, Target="Microsoft Graph", Method=RequestMethod, Url=RequestUri),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where RequestClientApplication in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="CommonSecurityLog", Account=SourceUserName, IPAddress=SourceIP, UserAgent=RequestClientApplication, Target=DestinationHostName, Method=RequestMethod, Url=RequestURL),
    (W3CIISLog | where csUserAgent in (CodeUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="W3CIISLog", Account=csUserName, IPAddress=cIP, UserAgent=csUserAgent, Target=csHost, Method=csMethod, Url=csUriStem)
| extend Path = tolower(tostring(split(Url, "?")[0]))
| summarize Events=count(), NonGet=countif(isnotempty(Method) and Method != "GET"), StaticHits=countif(Path has_any (StaticExt)),
    Targets=make_set(Target, 10), SampleURLs=make_set(Url, 10), Sources=make_set(Source),
    FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Account, IPAddress, UserAgent
| where UserAgent == "artex-update-check" or (NonGet == 0 and StaticHits == 0)

properties.displayName: Service principal assigned a role by itself
properties.description:
A service principal added a directory role or app role assignment to itself, as compromised applications did in the Storm-0940 ARTEX campaign.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName in ("Add member to role", "Add app role assignment to service principal", "Add app role assignment grant to user")
| extend InitiatorId = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId), InitiatorName = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)
| where isnotempty(InitiatorId)
| mv-expand Target = TargetResources
| extend TargetId = tostring(Target.id), TargetName = tostring(Target.displayName)
| where TargetId == InitiatorId
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatorName, InitiatorId, TargetName, Result, CorrelationId

properties.displayName: ARTEX agentic attack framework user agent
properties.description:
A sign-in, cloud API call or web request carried a user agent that names the ARTEX framework or its renamed builds.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX): https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting
properties.query:
let ArtexUA = dynamic(["artex-readonly/","artex-pentest/","artex-audit/","artex-verify/","artex-spawn/","ARTEX-worker/","artex-enrich/","artex-i21861-canary","artex-agent","artex-judge-","ARTeX-authorized-pentest","Mozilla/5.0 ARTeX","Mozilla/5.0 (ARTEX)","ArtExVerify/","ArtEx/1.0","scopeweaver","spa-api-recon"]);
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs | where UserAgent has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="SigninLogs", Account=UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where UserAgent has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs", Account=UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, UserAgent),
    (AWSCloudTrail | where UserAgent has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="AWSCloudTrail", Account=UserIdentityArn, IPAddress=SourceIpAddress, UserAgent),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where RequestClientApplication has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="CommonSecurityLog", Account=SourceUserName, IPAddress=SourceIP, UserAgent=RequestClientApplication),
    (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs | where UserAgent has_any (ArtexUA) | project TimeGenerated, Source="MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs", Account=coalesce(UserId, ServicePrincipalId, AppId), IPAddress=IPAddress, UserAgent)
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Sources=make_set(Source) by Account, IPAddress, UserAgent

properties.displayName: AutoPT LLM pentest agent run on a host
properties.description:
A host started the AutoPT agent (python main.py --name <service/CVE> --ip_addr <IP>, or the upstream autopt run
--benchmark-name ... --ip-addr ...) or wrote an AutoPT run result (src/result/<model>/<service>_<CVE>_<model>_FSM.jsonl).
AutoPT runs model-chosen shell commands with no approval step. Check who ran it and against which IP.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where (ProcessCommandLine has "main.py" and ProcessCommandLine has "--ip_addr" and ProcessCommandLine has "--name")
            or (ProcessCommandLine has "autopt" and ProcessCommandLine has "--benchmark-name" and ProcessCommandLine has "--ip-addr")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine),
    (DeviceFileEvents
        | where FileName endswith "_FSM.jsonl" and (FolderPath has "/result/" or FolderPath has @"\result\")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=FolderPath)
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName

properties.displayName: CAI AI pentest framework on a host or reporting from your network
properties.description:
A host ran the CAI (Cybersecurity AI, aliasrobotics/cai) command line as an API backend, TUI, with --yolo or
--unrestricted, installed cai-framework, started its continuous-ops loop runner or kali-security container, or
connected to logs.aliasrobotics.com, where CAI uploads its session logs (every 5 model interactions, even with
CAI_TELEMETRY=false), or to Alias's gateway and package index on TCP 666, 665 and 664.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(^|[/\\\s])cai(\.exe)?[""']?\s(.*\s)?(--api|--api-host|--api-port|--tui|--yaml|--prompt|--yolo|--unrestricted)([\s=]|$)"
            or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"((pip|pip3|pipx)\s+install|uv\s+(tool\s+install|tool\s+run|pip\s+install|add)|uvx)\s(.*\s)?[""']?cai-framework"
            or ProcessCommandLine has "packages.aliasrobotics.com" or ProcessCommandLine has "cai.continuous_ops.loop_runner"
            or (ProcessCommandLine has "--name kali-security" and ProcessCommandLine has "seccomp=unconfined")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents
        | where RemoteUrl has_any ("logs.aliasrobotics.com", "api.aliasrobotics.com", "packages.aliasrobotics.com")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=strcat(RemoteUrl, ":", RemotePort, " ", InitiatingProcessCommandLine))
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName

properties.displayName: Traffic to or from published Cairn campaign infrastructure
properties.description:
A connection, DNS query, sign-in or web request involved an address or domain published for Cairn operations:
JPCERT/CC Case E, NorForge AIA0002 staging servers, or the staging, C2 and skimmer hosts Gambit Security recovered from
an operator using Hermes, Strix and Cairn. Addresses are reassigned: check the review_by date in iocs/indicators.csv.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (Cairn): https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
let CairnIPs = dynamic(["199.247.25.25", "199.247.27.2", "31.59.92.155", "31.56.206.187", "38.244.50.120", "46.8.227.73", "64.44.24.195", "94.183.184.98", "94.183.184.254", "95.182.99.112", "176.65.144.71", "155.254.22.215", "209.126.4.170", "213.21.239.62", "172.245.224.188", "172.245.89.137"]);
let CairnDomains = dynamic(["medbooksource.com", "traffic-analyzer.net", "b8t.shop", "cdn.netlfjs.com", "x1opay.co", "static-js.com", "cdn.js-static.com", "js-static.com", "jsnetlify.com", "netlifyjs.com", "newssjs.com"]);
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog | where SourceIP in (CairnIPs) or DestinationIP in (CairnIPs) or DestinationHostName has_any (CairnDomains)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="CommonSecurityLog", Indicator=coalesce(DestinationHostName, DestinationIP), Peer=SourceIP),
    (DnsEvents | where Name has_any (CairnDomains) | project TimeGenerated, Source="DnsEvents", Indicator=Name, Peer=ClientIP),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | where RemoteIP in (CairnIPs) or RemoteUrl has_any (CairnDomains)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="DeviceNetworkEvents", Indicator=coalesce(RemoteUrl, RemoteIP), Peer=DeviceName),
    (SigninLogs | where IPAddress in (CairnIPs) | project TimeGenerated, Source="SigninLogs", Indicator=IPAddress, Peer=UserPrincipalName)
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by Source, Indicator, Peer

properties.displayName: Cairn dispatcher, server or worker artifacts on a host
properties.description:
A process or file carried a marker only Cairn creates: cairn serve / cairn dispatch, a cairn-dispatch-<project>
worker container, the /tmp/cairn-prompts/ task snapshots, the /tmp/cairn-pi/ provider keys or the tsec-actions skill
copied from the Tencent competition setup.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (Cairn): https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("cairn serve", "cairn dispatch", "cairn-dispatch-", "cairn-worker-container")
            or ProcessCommandLine contains "/tmp/cairn-pi/" or ProcessCommandLine contains "/tmp/cairn-prompts/"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine, Kind="process"),
    (DeviceFileEvents
        | where FolderPath contains "/tmp/cairn-prompts/" or FolderPath contains "/tmp/cairn-pi/" or FolderPath contains "/skills/tsec-actions/"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, Detail=FolderPath, Kind="file")
| summarize Events=count(), Details=make_set(Detail, 10), Kinds=make_set(Kind), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated) by DeviceName

properties.displayName: Cyber-AutoAgent AI pentest agent on a host
properties.description:
A host started the Cyber-AutoAgent Python agent (cyberautoagent.py with --target or --service-mode, or the
--objective via environment placeholder its terminal front end passes for every run), ran a container from the
cyber-autoagent image, or ran the dalfox command its general module builds with the callback dalfox-xss-test.com.
Cyber-AutoAgent runs shell, HTTP and Python tools against a target without asking for approval by default.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (ProcessCommandLine has "cyberautoagent.py" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--target", "--service-mode"))
    or ProcessCommandLine has "--objective via environment"
    or ProcessCommandLine has "cyber-autoagent:latest"
    or (ProcessCommandLine has "dalfox" and ProcessCommandLine has "dalfox-xss-test.com")
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Commands=make_set(substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 300), 10)
    by DeviceName, AccountName

properties.displayName: CyberStrikeAI implant persistence
properties.description:
A host created the persistence the CyberStrikeAI implant uses: a Run value or scheduled task named SystemUpdate
(schtasks /sc onlogon /rl highest), an @reboot crontab entry piped through sort -u, 
or a com.apple.systemupdate LaunchAgent. Kaspersky saw the SystemUpdate task and Run value in real attacks.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (DeviceProcessEvents
        | where (ProcessCommandLine contains @"CurrentVersion\Run" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @'(?i)/v\s+"?SystemUpdate\b')
            or (ProcessCommandLine has "schtasks" and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @'(?i)/tn\s+"?\\?SystemUpdate\b')
            or (ProcessCommandLine contains "@reboot" and ProcessCommandLine contains "sort -u | crontab -")
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, Detail=ProcessCommandLine),
    (DeviceRegistryEvents
        | where RegistryKey endswith @"\CurrentVersion\Run" and RegistryValueName =~ "SystemUpdate"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=RegistryValueData),
    (DeviceFileEvents
        | where FileName =~ "com.apple.systemupdate.plist" and FolderPath has "/Library/LaunchAgents/"
        | project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName, Detail=FolderPath)
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(Detail, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName

properties.displayName: CyberStrikeAI webshell manager or OS probe
properties.description:
A web or proxy request carried a user agent hard-coded in CyberStrikeAI (CyberStrikeAI-WebShell/1.0 from its webshell
manager, or CyberStrikeAI/<version> from the console), or a process ran its webshell OS probe "echo :OSPROBE_%OS%:END".
The probe runs as a child of the web server once a webshell is in place, so treat a hit as a compromised server.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (CommonSecurityLog | where RequestClientApplication has "CyberStrikeAI" or RequestURL contains "OSPROBE_"
        | project TimeGenerated, Host=DestinationHostName, Src=SourceIP, Detail=strcat(RequestClientApplication, " ", RequestURL)),
    (W3CIISLog | extend UA=replace_string(csUserAgent, "+", " ") | where UA has "CyberStrikeAI" or csUriQuery contains "OSPROBE_"
        | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, Src=cIP, Detail=strcat(UA, " ", csUriStem)),
    (DeviceProcessEvents | where ProcessCommandLine contains "OSPROBE_"
        | project TimeGenerated, Host=DeviceName, Src="", Detail=strcat(InitiatingProcessFileName, " -> ", ProcessCommandLine))
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Samples=make_set(Detail, 10) by Host, Src

properties.displayName: DarkMoon AI pentest agent running on a host
properties.description:
A host pulled or ran the DarkMoon containers (ascit/darkmoon, ascit/opencode-darkmoon), started a DarkMoon campaign
(opencode run --agent pentest with a TARGET line, through darkmoon.sh), or ran the DarkMoon MCP server wrapper.
DarkMoon is an open-source autonomous penetration testing stack whose agents run every command, with no approval,
as root in a toolbox container that holds the host's Docker socket.
Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where (ProcessCommandLine has "opencode" and ProcessCommandLine contains "--agent pentest" and ProcessCommandLine contains "TARGET:")
    or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(^|[/\s])darkmoon\.sh(\s|$)"
    or ProcessCommandLine contains "ascit/darkmoon" or ProcessCommandLine contains "ascit/opencode-darkmoon"
    or ProcessCommandLine contains "docker exec -i darkmoon darkmoon-mcp"
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(substring(ProcessCommandLine, 0, 300), 10) by DeviceName, AccountName

properties.displayName: Decepticon AI red team agent on a host or reporting from your network
properties.description:
A host installed or started Decepticon (decepticon.red/install, ghcr.io/bittersecurity/decepticon-* images), ran its
sandbox command daemon or tmux completion hook, created its Sliver operator decepticon, or sent Decepticon usage

properties.displayName: Indicator sweep with the agentic watchlist (agent-zero)
properties.query:
// Indicator sweep with the agentic watchlist
// Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (Agent Zero). Source: https://github.com/ThreatDefence/agentic-attack-detections
// ATT&CK: T1595 (Active Scanning), T1071 (Application Layer Protocol)
// Upload feeds/sentinel-watchlist.csv as a Microsoft Sentinel watchlist with the alias AGENTIC_IOCs and the search key
// "value". A match needs investigation. Addresses are reassigned, so check the reported date and review_by. GTIG
// published no Agent Zero indicators, so these rows are fingerprints of the software and its exposed UIs.

let IOC = _GetWatchlist('AGENTIC_IOCs') | where framework has "agent-zero" | project value=tostring(SearchKey), type, confidence, actor, source;
let IPList = toscalar(IOC | where type in ("ipv4", "ipv6") | summarize make_list(value));
let UAs = toscalar(IOC | where type == "user_agent" and confidence in ("high", "medium") | summarize make_list(value));
let Domains = toscalar(IOC | where type == "domain" | summarize make_list(value));
let MD5s = toscalar(IOC | where type == "md5" | summarize make_list(value));
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where IPAddress in (IPList) or UserAgent has_any (UAs)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="SigninLogs", Indicator=coalesce(IPAddress, UserAgent), Detail=UserPrincipalName),
    (AWSCloudTrail | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where SourceIpAddress in (IPList) or UserAgent has_any (UAs)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="AWSCloudTrail", Indicator=SourceIpAddress, Detail=strcat(EventName, " ", UserIdentityArn)),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where SourceIP in (IPList) or DestinationIP in (IPList) or RequestClientApplication has_any (UAs) or DestinationHostName has_any (Domains)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="CommonSecurityLog", Detail=RequestURL,
            Indicator=case(SourceIP in (IPList), SourceIP, DestinationIP in (IPList), DestinationIP, DestinationHostName)),
    (W3CIISLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)

// Application reconnaissance in web logs
// Agentic attack detections by ThreatDefence (ARTEX). Source: https://threatdefence.com/article/artex-agentic-attack-framework-detection-hunting

    RequestURL endswith ".js.map", "source map",
    RequestURL has "/env.js" or RequestURL has "/assets/config.json", "runtime config",
    RequestURL has "format=openapi" or RequestURL has "swagger", "API documentation",
    RequestURL has "GeneratePasswordResetToken" or RequestURL has "ValidateUserName" or RequestURL has "forgot_password", "account recovery",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Marker)
| summarize Requests=count(), Markers=make_set(Marker), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
    Agents=make_set(RequestClientApplication, 10)
    by SourceIP, DestinationHostName
| where array_length(Markers) >= 2 or Markers has "not-found canary" or Markers has "unsigned token"
| order by Requests desc

        | where IPAddress in (IPList) or UserAgent has_any (UAs)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="SigninLogs", Indicator=coalesce(IPAddress, UserAgent), Detail=UserPrincipalName),
    (AWSCloudTrail | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where SourceIpAddress in (IPList) or UserAgent has_any (UAs)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="AWSCloudTrail", Indicator=SourceIpAddress, Detail=strcat(EventName, " ", UserIdentityArn)),
    (CommonSecurityLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where SourceIP in (IPList) or DestinationIP in (IPList) or RequestClientApplication has_any (UAs) or DestinationHostName has_any (Domains)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="CommonSecurityLog", Detail=RequestURL,
            Indicator=case(SourceIP in (IPList), SourceIP, DestinationIP in (IPList), DestinationIP, DestinationHostName)),
    (W3CIISLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where cIP in (IPList) or replace_string(csUserAgent, "+", " ") has_any (UAs)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="W3CIISLog", Indicator=cIP, Detail=csUriStem),
    (DeviceNetworkEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
        | where RemoteIP in (IPList) or RemoteUrl has_any (Domains)
        | project TimeGenerated=Timestamp, Source="DeviceNetworkEvents", Indicator=iff(RemoteIP in (IPList), RemoteIP, RemoteUrl),
            Detail=strcat(DeviceName, " ", InitiatingProcessFileName)),
    (DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
        | where MD5 in~ (MD5s)
        | project TimeGenerated=Timestamp, Source="DeviceFileEvents", Indicator=tolower(MD5), Detail=strcat(DeviceName, " ", FolderPath)),
    (DeviceProcessEvents | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
        | where MD5 in~ (MD5s)
        | project TimeGenerated=Timestamp, Source="DeviceProcessEvents", Indicator=tolower(MD5), Detail=strcat(DeviceName, " ", FolderPath)),
    (DnsEvents | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
        | where Name has_any (Domains)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source="DnsEvents", Indicator=Name, Detail=ClientIP)
| join kind=leftouter (IOC) on $left.Indicator == $right.value
| summarize Events=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Details=make_set(Detail, 10)
    by Source, Indicator, actor, confidence
| order by LastSeen desc
